ottoextra.consent.title: OttoExtra – Privacy and downloads
ottoextra.consent.page.0.heading: You decide
ottoextra.consent.page.0.body: OttoExtra can retrieve files and version information from the internet. This guide asks about each optional function separately. Nothing is preselected. You can decline everything and still use OttoExtra.
ottoextra.consent.page.1.heading: Automatic resource-pack downloads
ottoextra.consent.page.1.body: May OttoExtra automatically download and update the Ottonien resource pack now and in the future, store it in the Minecraft folder, and enable it?
ottoextra.consent.page.1.details: Source: api.github.com and github.com/Ottonien/ottonien-reformed. File: Ottonien.zip. Destination: resourcepacks/Ottonien.zip. Size limit: 64 MB. Revoke through config/ottoextra/ottoextra.json.
ottoextra.consent.page.2.heading: External images
ottoextra.consent.page.2.body: May OttoExtra download player skins from texture servers listed in Minecraft profiles and region banners from api.ottoextra.dev, then cache them locally?
ottoextra.consent.page.2.details: File type: PNG. Destination: config/ottoextra/cache. Purpose: heads, people book, map, and region displays. Without consent, default or existing images are used.
ottoextra.consent.page.3.heading: Version check
ottoextra.consent.page.3.body: May OttoExtra ask the GitHub API for a newer OttoExtra version at startup?
ottoextra.consent.page.3.details: Source: api.github.com. Normal HTTP connection data and the installed version in the User-Agent are transmitted. No mod file is downloaded; an update link opens the browser only after your click.
ottoextra.consent.page.4.heading: Share observed RP names
ottoextra.consent.page.4.body: May OttoExtra automatically send RP names you see in Ottonien chat to api.ottoextra.dev to update the shared player directory?
ottoextra.consent.page.4.details: Data sent: your Minecraft account name or UUID, plus the observed player's RP name, account name, and UUID when available. Without consent, all observations remain local.
